top_findings.title: server.ts does not compile: express() not callable (TS2349)
top_findings.evidence: src/server.ts:1,4 `import * as express from 'express'` then `const app = express()` — under this tsconfig (esModuleInterop:true) the namespace import is not callable, raising TS2349. Agent self-reported this in _agent_stdout.log and left it unfixed; `npm run build`/`npm start` fail.
top_findings.suggestion: Use a default import: `import express from 'express'` (and `import type { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express'`).

top_findings.title: Nested test files use wrong relative import depth (../src instead of ../../src)
top_findings.evidence: tests/unit/validation.test.ts:1 imports '../src/middleware/validation' → resolves to tests/src/... (nonexistent); tests/integration/api.test.ts:2-3 import '../src/server' and '../src/database/database' → tests/src/... (nonexistent). Both suites (28 of 38 `it` blocks) fail to load; only tests/database.test.ts (10 tests) runs. Matches partial test_coverage=0.2645 in scores.json.
top_findings.suggestion: Change to '../../src/...' in files under tests/unit/ and tests/integration/, or add a jest moduleNameMapper/rootDir so paths resolve.
